event.enigma.play.zh-CN: 恩尼格玛：本行动中轴心国公开手牌：{cards}。
event.enigma.play.en: Enigma: the Axis hand is public for this action: {cards}.

event.krim.play.zh-CN: 克里木：本行动中对塞瓦斯托波尔的一次攻击忽略苏军要塞战斗效果。
event.krim.play.en: Krim: one attack on Sevastopol during this action ignores the Soviet fort's combat effects.

event.panzergruppe_guderian.play.zh-CN: 古德里安装甲集群：德国第2装甲集团军完成首次攻击后，可在全部常规战斗结束时再攻击一次；第二次战斗最多推进一格。
event.panzergruppe_guderian.play.en: Panzergruppe Guderian: after the German 2nd Panzer Army completes its first attack, it may attack again after all regular combats; its second combat may advance at most one space.

event.patton.play.zh-CN: 巴顿：美国第3集团军完成首次攻击后，可在常规战斗结束时再攻击一次；第二次战斗最多推进两格。
event.patton.play.en: Patton: after the US 3rd Army completes its first attack, it may attack again after regular combat; its second combat may advance at most two spaces.

event.wacht_am_rhein.play.zh-CN: 守望莱茵：放置4个战斗标记；本行动轮德国第5装甲集团军或第6党卫军装甲集团军参加对非苏军的攻击时+2 DRM。
event.wacht_am_rhein.play.en: Wacht am Rhein: place four combat markers; during this action round, attacks against non-Soviet units receive +2 DRM when the German 5th Panzer Army or 6th SS Panzer Army participates.

event.zitadelle.play.zh-CN: 堡垒行动：放置2个战斗标记；本行动轮苏军防御射击+2 DRM。德国装甲集团军若推进占领原有至少2个LCU的苏联空间则VP+1，否则VP-1。
event.zitadelle.play.en: Fall Zitadelle: place two combat markers; Soviet defensive fire receives +2 DRM this action round. Gain 1 VP if a German Panzer Army advances into a Soviet space that began with at least two LCUs; otherwise lose 1 VP.

event.foreign_armies_east.reveal.zh-CN: 东方外军处：盟军公开手中的指定牌：{cards}。
event.foreign_armies_east.reveal.en: Foreign Armies East: the Allied player reveals the specified cards: {cards}.

event.foreign_armies_east.reveal_final.zh-CN: 东方外军处：盟军在回合末再次公开未打出的指定牌：{cards}。
event.foreign_armies_east.reveal_final.en: Foreign Armies East: at the end of the turn, the Allied player again reveals the specified unplayed cards: {cards}.

events.air_supply.space.zh-CN: 空军补给：选择一个含断补轴心单位的空间。
events.air_supply.space.en: Luftwaffe Supply: choose a space containing out-of-supply Axis units.

events.log.air_supply_placed.zh-CN: 空军补给标记放置在{space}；其中轴心单位本回合防御与损耗时视为有限补给。
events.log.air_supply_placed.en: Place the Luftwaffe Supply marker in {space}; Axis units there are treated as in Limited Supply for defense and Attrition this turn.

events.log.reinforcement_yellow_event.zh-CN: {card}的安特卫普增援改作黄色事件，获得 {ops} OPS；不放置免费激活标记。
events.log.reinforcement_yellow_event.en: {card}'s Antwerp reinforcement is treated as a Yellow Event for {ops} OPS; no free activation marker is placed.

events.atlantic_wall.select.zh-CN: 大西洋壁垒：选择 2 个空间（{count}/2）。

events.banzai.select.zh-CN: 万岁冲锋：依次从地图、预备箱、已消灭单位池选择英联邦军（{count}/2）。
events.banzai.select.en: Banzai: choose Commonwealth corps in order from the map, Reserve Box, and Eliminated Units Box ({count}/2).

events.east_wall.select.zh-CN: 东方壁垒：选择 3 个空间（{count}/3）。

events.final_production.select.zh-CN: 最后生产冲刺：选择 3 个减员德国装甲集团军（{count}/3）。
events.final_production.select.en: Final Production Surge: choose three reduced German Panzer armies ({count}/3).

events.front.replace.zh-CN: 选择满编 3-3-3 苏军方面军，由{label}替换。
events.front.replace.en: Choose a full-strength 3-3-3 Soviet Front to be replaced by {label}.

events.german_reinforcement.transfer.zh-CN: 『德国增援』：选择一支在利比亚或埃及且有补给的德国装甲军调回预备箱。
events.german_reinforcement.transfer.en: German Reinforcements: choose a supplied German Panzer corps in Libya or Egypt to return to the Reserve Box.

events.hedgehogs.select.zh-CN: 刺猬阵地：选择 3 个空间（{count}/3）。

events.invasion.mode.zh-CN: 『{event}』：选择一个盟军滩头或两个国别滩头。
events.invasion.mode.en: {event}: choose one Allied beachhead or two national beachheads.

events.marker.optional.zh-CN: 可放置一个移动或战斗标记。
events.marker.optional.en: You may place one Move or Combat marker.

events.reinforcement.antwerp_1945_choice.en: {space}: choose a free activation marker or {ops} OPS.

events.panzer_refit.select.zh-CN: 装甲部队整补：选择 1 至 3 个有补给的减员德国装甲单位（{count}/3）。
events.panzer_refit.select.en: Panzer Refit: choose one to three supplied reduced German Panzer units ({count}/3).

events.partisan_sweep.remove.zh-CN: 『反游击队扫荡』：移除游击队（剩余 {remaining}）。

events.reinforcement.deploy_desert.zh-CN: 部署{unit}（亚历山大、开罗或巴士拉）。
events.reinforcement.deploy_desert.en: Deploy {unit} in Alexandria, Cairo, or Basra.

events.reinforcement.deploy_standard.zh-CN: 部署{unit}（本国完整补给城市或补给源）。
events.reinforcement.deploy_standard.en: Deploy {unit} in a friendly full-supply city or supply source.

events.reinforcement.deploy_western.zh-CN: 部署{unit}（本国入口、港口或可用滩头）。
events.reinforcement.deploy_western.en: Deploy {unit} at a national entry space, port, or available beachhead.

events.reserve.transfer_army.zh-CN: 将英国第8集团军或美国第7集团军移入预备箱。
events.reserve.transfer_army.en: Move the British 8th Army or US 7th Army to the Reserve Box.

events.tito.space.zh-CN: 『铁托』：选择南斯拉夫部署空间。
events.tito.space.en: Tito: choose a Yugoslav deployment space.
